title: VisionAskRequest
description: vision.ask-request@1: the body of POST /api/v1/ask and /api/v1/describe on OpenVibe.Vision. `task` is what the caller wants (ask, describe, identify, count, translate, ocr); `mode` is auto (local OCR first, then OpenVibe.AI), local (never a model) or ai. A read question (text, sign, receipt, label) is answered by the local OCR reader first in auto mode. `lang` is the Tesseract language and `model` is a provider:model hint AI may ignore.

image.description: The image as a data URL (base64).

image_url.description: A public image URL, fetched through Vision's private-address guard.
